integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the shifted quadratic form, long-interval test functions, Persson threshold separation and a ray-tail pigeonhole argument. The bundled checker verifies only finite algebraic/combinatorial components and is not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
limitations: Finite metric stars; exactly constant nonnegative ray potentials; non-covering connected Dirichlet partitions. No extension is claimed to variable asymptotic potentials, magnetic couplings, nonlinear energies, or general compact-core graphs.
title: Lowest-channel multiplicity controls spectral-partition attainment on a quantum star
